title: What is Expo?
overview: Expo is a framework built on top of React Native that provides tools, libraries, and services to simplify mobile app development.

example.title: Expo Purpose
example.content:
React Native
      ↓
Expo Framework
      ↓
Mobile Application

title: Expo vs React Native CLI
overview: Expo provides a managed workflow with built-in tools, while React Native CLI gives more control over native Android and iOS projects.

example.title: Comparison
example.content:
Expo:
✔ Faster setup
✔ Built-in APIs
✔ Easier development

React Native CLI:
✔ Full native control
✔ Custom native code

title: Expo Managed Workflow
overview: The managed workflow allows developers to build apps without directly managing native Android and iOS folders.

example.title: Managed Workflow
example.content:
JavaScript / TypeScript Code
          ↓
Expo Tools
          ↓
Android & iOS App

title: Expo Go Application
overview: Expo Go allows developers to preview and test Expo applications instantly on physical devices without creating a native build.

example.title: Expo Go Flow
example.content:
Write Code
 ↓
Start Expo Server
 ↓
Scan QR Code
 ↓
Run App

title: Expo SDK
overview: Expo SDK provides ready-to-use libraries for accessing device features like camera, notifications, location, and sensors.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned what Expo is, its benefits, workflow types, Expo Go, and Expo SDK libraries.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ Expo simplifies React Native development.
✔ Expo provides ready-made APIs.
✔ Expo Go helps test apps quickly.
